d: Do Bigha Zamin is the story of a farmer Shambu Mahato (Balraj Sahni), who lives with his wife Paro (Nirupa Roy) and son Kanhaiya (Rattan Kumar) in a small village that has been badly affected by famine. The local zamindar Thakur Harnam Singh (Murad) partners with some city business men to construct a mill on his large parcel of land, which in return would profit them and bring prosperity to the village.
